title: Resolve Test IDs in Test Events
description: Resolve all test definition IDs from test commands in agent.tool.test.starting and agent.tool.test.ended events. Parse commands like 'go test -v ./repo/cli/...' to find all test files, extract test definitions, and add their IDs to the tests array. Support Go, Python, JS/TS, Rust, C#, Ruby test frameworks.
summary: Implemented test file resolution from commands (Go, Python, JS/TS, Rust, C#, Ruby) and test definition ID extraction with section paths. Modified extractTestStartingFromInput and extractTestEndedFromInput to resolve test IDs. Added 19 sub-tests. Fixed pre-existing test failures: claude/PreToolUse/Bash expectation (terminal->test), claude/PreToolUse/Grep (generic->search), and session.json file count in SessionStart/SubagentStart tests.
